div.h1: Become a Certified TRE™ Provider — 2027 Cohort (Singapore)

p.strong: Apr–Oct 2027 · Module 1: 24–25 Apr · Module 2: 3–4 Jul · Module 3: 30–31 Oct 2027 · Singapore (venue confirmed on registration) · In-Person + online sessions

div.p: With Isabelle Claus Teixeira & Simba Stenqvist

The 2027 Singapore cohort of the Global TRE™ Provider Certification — co-taught by Isabelle Claus Teixeira and Simba Stenqvist, and boosted by Internal Alchemy. Choose from three package families: Growth, Foundational or Refresher. One cohort per year.
The Global TRE™ Provider Certification qualifies you to offer TRE™ to the general public, in individual and group settings.

The 2027 Singapore cohort is boosted by Internal Alchemy and co-taught by two TRE™ Trainers — Isabelle Claus Teixeira and Simba Stenqvist — for richer, varied learning. Only one cohort runs in Singapore each year.

ul.li: A coach (ACC, PCC, MCC or in training) wanting somatic tools
A therapist, counsellor or psychologist seeking body-based approaches
An HR, wellbeing or corporate resilience professional
A yoga teacher, physiotherapist or movement practitioner
Someone who has experienced TRE™ and wants to share it professionally

Growth Package (New students): early bird S$5,888, regular S$6,888. The full certification: Modules 1–3, all online personal sessions and supervisions, ICF credits and the three self-paced bonus programmes (together valued at S$1,290). Instalments S$1,888 + S$2,000 + S$2,000.

Foundational Package (New students): early bird S$4,888, regular S$5,888. The complete certification pathway, without ICF credits and without the bonus programmes. Instalments S$1,888 + S$1,500 + S$1,500.

Refresher Packages (Accredited TRE™ Providers and TRE™ Provider trainees): early bird from S$2,200, regular from S$2,900. Four options to complete your training: Refresher, Supervised Refresher, Boosted Refresher and Boosted Supervised Refresher. Early bird S$2,200 to S$3,990.

div.p: Growth Package · Foundational Package · Refresher Packages

ul.li: Module 1 24–25 Apr 2027 · Singapore · SGT — Your Personal TRE™ Practice — A 2-day in-person workshop plus personal sessions: 2 online individual and 2 online group sessions (group sessions on 5 May & 1 Jun 2027). ICF CCEs are released on full attendance (Module 1 = 21 CCEs) in the Growth Package.
Module 2 3–4 Jul 2027 · Singapore · SGT — Teaching TRE™ to One Person — A 2-day in-person workshop plus 2 online group supervisions (19 Jul & 16 Aug 2027) and 2 online individual supervisions.

Module 3 30–31 Oct 2027 · Singapore · SGT — Teaching TRE™ to Groups — A 2-day in-person workshop plus 3 online individual supervisions and 1 online group supervision (13 Nov 2027). The final module: complete it, its supervisions and the remaining certification requirements to become a Global TRE™ Provider.

Bonuses Self-paced online · Growth Package — Three bonus programmes (value S$1,290) — Three self-paced online programmes, together valued at S$1,290, come with this package. Grounding unlocks once Instalment 2 is received (due by 3 June 2027). Verbal Interventions and Internal Alchemy unlock once Instalment 3 is received (due by 30 September 2027). If you pay the full package price at registration, all three unlock after Module 2 (3–4 July 2027).
Three 2-day in-person workshops — Modules 1, 2 & 3 in Singapore
Taught by 2 TRE™ Trainers — varied perspectives and richer learning
Online personal sessions and supervisions — individual and group, across all three modules

Growth Package only: ICF credits (21 CCEs for Module 1; Module 2 pending confirmation) and three self-paced bonus programmes (together valued at S$1,290) — Grounding, Verbal Interventions and Internal Alchemy
Global TRE™ Certification upon completion of all requirements — qualify to offer TRE™ to individuals and groups
Extra 60-minute online personal sessions or supervisions: S$190 per session, with any package
Growth Package (new students · Modules 1–3 + ICF credits + 3 bonuses) — S$5,888 — early bird to 31 Mar 2027 · then S$6,888
Foundational Package (new students · Modules 1–3, no ICF credits or bonuses) — S$4,888 — early bird to 31 Mar 2027 · then S$5,888
Refresher Packages (accredited Providers and trainees · 4 options) — from S$2,200 — early bird to 31 Mar 2027 · then from S$2,900

div.p: All prices in Singapore Dollars. Early-bird pricing applies until 31 March 2027. Payment is by credit card only, through Stripe (Odoo checkout), and card charges are added on top of every instalment. The full package price is owed once the first instalment is paid; you can also pay the full package price at registration instead of three instalments. Extra 60-minute online personal sessions or supervisions are S$190 each. All ticket sales are final, non-refundable and non-cancellable.

ul.li: Isabelle Claus Teixeira, Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer · ICF PCC. Somatic and trauma-informed Executive Coach (ICF PCC), Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer and Mindfulness Teacher. Trained directly under Dr. David Berceli, founder of TRE™. Over 30 years of experience working with professionals, executives and teams across 9 countries and 40+ nationalities — in person and online.

Simba Stenqvist, Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer · Creator of Internal Alchemy. Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer and creator of Internal Alchemy — an integrated system of breathwork, fascial release, grounding and tremor work drawn from more than 25 years of hands-on practice in bodywork, nervous-system regulation and energetic healing, developed in close collaboration with Dr. David Berceli.
